description: This file defines the CallsQuickCreate class, which extends the QuickCreate class to handle the creation of call records in SuiteCRM. It initializes form fields, manages default values for call start date and time, and sets up JavaScript interactions for the quick create form.

classes.name: CallsQuickCreate
classes.description: A class to handle the quick creation of Call records, setting up form defaults, JavaScript interactions, and rendering options.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the quick create form with default values, assigns JavaScript functionality, and sets up form fields like start date, time, duration, and options for call direction and status.
